narrative.title: The Courier's Return-Address Stack
narrative.scenario: A night-shift courier audits a delivery franchise's hub-and-branch chart without a guide — no recursive dispatchers allowed after midnight. Armed with a clipboard stack of pending stops, he stamps a hub the moment he reaches it and jots its two branches as pending return addresses. By popping the left branch before the right, his stamp order mirrors the official root-first audit sheet.
narrative.inputFormat: The root of a binary tree given as a level-order array where null marks a missing child.
narrative.outputFormat: Return an array of node values in preorder, produced without recursion.
constraints: No recursive calls allowed — the traversal must run on an explicit stack

testCases.explanation: Identical to recursive preorder: root, left wing, right wing.
One node, one stamp — the stack empties immediately after.

hintLevels: Level 1: Recursion's call stack is doing the bookkeeping for you — replicate it with a real stack data structure.
Level 2: Pop a node, record it, then push its right child before its left so the left surfaces on top and is handled first.
Level 3: Push children only when they exist; the loop ends the moment the stack drains, which is your termination signal.
